rules.statement: Every production solution MUST document context, deployables, repositories, owners, and external dependencies.
rules.verification: Solution release review
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Trust boundaries, data flows, failure modes, and deployment topology MUST be documented.
rules.verification: Threat and deployment review
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Solutions MUST pin their standards baseline and record scoped exceptions.
rules.verification: Baseline and exception review
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Frontend and backend MUST have separate application repositories and release pipelines.
rules.verification: Repository and pipeline review
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Features MUST NOT import another feature’s internal implementation; use its documented public API or app-level composition.
rules.verification: Import boundary lint
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: HTTP calls MUST pass through the approved API client layer; generated files MUST NOT be manually edited.
rules.verification: Import lint and regeneration diff
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Business-specific logic MUST stay in its feature and shared code MUST NOT depend on features.
rules.verification: Import boundary lint
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: UI MUST provide accessible keyboard navigation, semantic controls, and loading, empty, and failure states.
rules.verification: Accessibility and component checks
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Domain MUST NOT depend on Application, Infrastructure, API, HTTP, or persistence frameworks.
rules.verification: Assembly and package architecture tests
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Application MUST NOT depend on Infrastructure or API.
rules.verification: Assembly architecture tests
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Infrastructure MUST implement ports owned by Application or Domain.
rules.verification: Architecture tests and design review
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Endpoints MUST delegate business decisions to application/domain code and enforce documented authorization.
rules.verification: API tests and endpoint review
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Module data MUST be accessed through its owned interfaces; cross-module writes MUST NOT bypass ownership.
rules.verification: Module dependency tests and data review
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: HTTP APIs MUST publish versioned OpenAPI artifacts and use a documented error contract.
rules.verification: Contract publication and API tests
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Breaking contract changes MUST retain a documented migration and supported compatibility window.
rules.verification: Contract diff and consumer compatibility tests
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Mutation retries MUST account for idempotency and ambiguous network outcomes.
rules.verification: Retry and duplicate-delivery tests
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: Trace context MUST propagate across supported boundaries without secrets or sensitive payloads in telemetry.
rules.verification: Trace integration and redaction checks
rules.applies_when: the solution includes this domain; assess the linked architecture scope

rules.statement: APIs MUST follow the resource, method, representation, and status conventions in this document.
rules.verification: HTTP contract tests for successful and failing operations
rules.applies_when: an application exposes an HTTP API

rules.statement: Collection endpoints MUST bound results and allowlist query operations.
rules.verification: Limit, cursor tampering, tenant scope, and sort-injection tests
rules.applies_when: an application exposes an HTTP API

rules.statement: Application errors MUST use the documented problem contract and stable codes.
rules.verification: Validate media type, status agreement, codes, and redaction
rules.applies_when: an application exposes an HTTP API

rules.statement: Updates vulnerable to lost writes MUST enforce an atomic concurrency policy.
rules.verification: Two competing updates: one succeeds and the stale write fails
rules.applies_when: an application exposes an HTTP API

rules.statement: API consumers MUST pin reproducibly generated client contracts to immutable artifacts.
rules.verification: Clean regeneration diff and checksum verification
rules.applies_when: separate repositories exchange HTTP contracts

rules.statement: Provider changes MUST assess structural and behavioral compatibility with supported consumers.
rules.verification: Contract diff plus consumer compatibility evidence
rules.applies_when: separate repositories exchange HTTP contracts

rules.statement: Every operation MUST document auth, validation, errors, concurrency, and retry behavior.
rules.verification: OpenAPI validation and operation review
rules.applies_when: separate repositories exchange HTTP contracts

rules.statement: Outbound calls MUST declare bounded deadlines and operation-safe retry behavior.
rules.verification: Timeout, cancellation, and retry-budget tests
rules.applies_when: operations retry, publish events, or call remote dependencies

rules.statement: Replay-sensitive mutations MUST implement a durable scoped idempotency protocol.
rules.verification: Concurrent duplicate, changed payload, restart, and expiry tests
rules.applies_when: operations retry, publish events, or call remote dependencies

rules.statement: Reliable database-to-event publication MUST coordinate through an outbox or documented equivalent.
rules.verification: Crash after commit/before publish and after publish tests
rules.applies_when: operations retry, publish events, or call remote dependencies

rules.statement: Consumers MUST handle duplicates, poison messages, shutdown, and authorized redrive.
rules.verification: Inbox, dead-letter, redrive, and shutdown integration tests
rules.applies_when: operations retry, publish events, or call remote dependencies

rules.statement: User journeys MUST support keyboard, focus, labels, error announcements, and the adopted accessibility target.
rules.verification: Automated accessibility plus manual keyboard/screen-reader evidence
rules.applies_when: a solution presents a browser UI

rules.statement: Applications MUST define measured performance budgets and asset/configuration caching behavior.
rules.verification: Production-build budget report and stale-asset deployment test
rules.applies_when: a solution presents a browser UI

rules.statement: Solution designs MUST resolve cross-domain implementation choices and document measurable quality scenarios.
rules.verification: Design packet with baseline, decision table, and acceptance scenarios

rules.statement: Production readiness MUST include failure, compatibility, security, operations, and recovery evidence.
rules.verification: Readiness review linked to actual test reports/runbooks

rules.statement: Business use cases MUST distinguish commands from queries without requiring separate stores or a mediator.

rules.statement: Queries MUST NOT mutate authoritative business state; commands MUST own atomic invariant enforcement.

rules.statement: Separate read models MUST declare consistency, authorization, lag, and rebuild behavior.

rules.statement: Application pipelines MUST preserve authorization, replay, and transaction semantics across HTTP and worker callers.

rules.statement: Backend hosts MUST centralize visible service/pipeline/endpoint composition and preserve documented ordering dependencies.

rules.statement: OpenAPI responses, schemas and security metadata MUST match implemented endpoint behavior.

rules.statement: Build-time contract generation MUST be isolated from production effects and pass consumer generation checks.
